description.p: A hunter born with a rare sensitivity to the faint elemental traces present almost everywhere — heat, frost, storm, thunder — spending years learning to aim what they were simply born able to touch.

Every element leaves some trace nearly everywhere in Atérior. An Elemental Marksman is someone born already sensitive enough to touch what's faintly there. Some reach for any element the moment calls for; others answer to only one, and nothing else ever responds no matter how hard they reach. Both are the same gift, just shaped differently by the person carrying it.
Marksman DC. Several of your techniques require a saving throw or check. The DC for these equals 8 + your Proficiency Bonus + your Wisdom modifier.

sheet.description: A hunter born with a rare sensitivity to the faint elemental traces present almost everywhere, spending years learning to aim what they were simply born able to touch.

description.p: You have 5 infusion dice (d6). When you make a weapon attack, expend 1 die to infuse it with Fire, Cold, Thunder, or Lightning, dealing extra damage of that type equal to the roll plus your Wisdom modifier on a hit. Regain all dice on a Long Rest.

description.p: Gain proficiency in Arcana or Nature. You automatically perceive a creature's resistances or immunities to acid, cold, fire, lightning, and thunder — advantage on checks to determine them otherwise.

sheet.description: You automatically perceive a creature's resistances or immunities to acid, cold, fire, lightning, and thunder, and have advantage on checks to determine them otherwise.

description.p: Your infusion die becomes a d8; your pool increases to 6. When you expend a die on a weapon attack, apply it as Elemental Infusion or trigger one known technique instead — never both from the same die. Learn 4 of the ten Level 7 Techniques below.

tr.td: On a hit, deals the infusion die's damage (fire) to every other creature within 10 ft. Half damage on a successful Dexterity save vs. Marksman DC.
On a hit, target makes a Constitution save vs. Marksman DC or drops one held item.
On a hit, target's Speed is halved until the start of your next turn.
On a hit, a 10-ft. radius around the target becomes Difficult Terrain until the start of your next turn.
On a hit, target makes a Strength save vs. Marksman DC or is pushed 10 ft. directly away from you.
Instead of attacking, expend 1 die as a Bonus Action to regain hit points equal to the roll plus your Wisdom modifier.
On a hit, target makes a Strength save vs. Marksman DC or falls Prone.
On a hit, deals the infusion die's damage (thunder) to every other creature within 10 ft. Half damage on a successful Constitution save vs. Marksman DC.
Reaction when you take damage: expend 1 die to reduce it by the roll plus your Wisdom modifier.
After hitting with an infused attack, expend 1 additional die for temporary hit points equal to the roll.

description.p: Your infusion die becomes a d12; your pool increases to 9. Learn 4 more from the list below, following the same one-die-one-effect rule as your Level 7 Techniques.

tr.td: On a hit, a line of fire from you to the target becomes Difficult Terrain until the start of your next turn.
On a hit, target makes a Constitution save vs. Marksman DC or is Blinded until the end of its next turn.
Instead of attacking, expend 1 die as an action for a 15-ft. cone: infusion die damage (cold), Strength save vs. Marksman DC or pushed 10 ft. and knocked Prone.
On a hit, a 20-ft.-radius zone centered on the target becomes Difficult Terrain until the start of your next turn.

On a hit, a 20-ft.-radius storm zone forms until the end of your next turn. Creatures starting their turn there, or entering for the first time on a turn, take infusion die damage (lightning) and have disadvantage on Concentration saves. No Concentration required from you.
Instead of attacking, expend 1 die as a Bonus Action to instantly move 15 ft. in a line; creatures in your path take infusion die damage (lightning).
On a hit, target makes a Strength save vs. Marksman DC or is Restrained (repeat save each turn, or Athletics check as an action). Each failure deals infusion die damage (bludgeoning).
On a hit, a flying target makes a Strength save vs. Marksman DC or falls Prone (normal fall damage). A grounded target instead has Speed halved until your next turn.
On a hit, target has disadvantage on its next attack roll; the next attack against it before then has advantage.
Instead of attacking, expend 1 die as a Bonus Action to teleport 30 ft. to an unoccupied space you can see.
